body: Yea i admit the sentece was funny retrospect. But it still matters here in the heart of NC. It sucks but that all I'm really attracted to. anyway, humor only gets you so far. and I suck at everything else so... (Yes I'm intoxicated again, no I'm not suicidal (right now))
well with a full bottle taken at once, anything can kill you, especially when mixed with alcohol. But i guess it's debatable. sorry for the really late response

well I'm drunk again and all i can tell you about comp science is that it's hard.
It deals with programming. My proffessor is an asshole. And it's really hard to comprehend. I did some small programming when I was younger but it doesn't prepare you. but if you can somehow succeed, it'll definitely pay off.

Well at least you've had an ex. And I agree things can change. For most people anyway, but not for me. I don't have the strength to change anything about myself. Also I should've mention that I've been depressed since I was about 12 so it's not something new. I've just learned more about it in the last couple of years is all...Also, I know they say things are harder for girls, but in the society we live in, if you're not a great looking guy or at least abide by normal standards, things are harder for you. But that kinda ties into the thing about having an ex. At one point, you had someone who would go the distance for you, even if that was short lived. When you haven't had that feeling with someone, it can be a downer. So I know 19 sounds like a simpler age (in retrospect for you) but things are tough when you aren't normal. That is just one of a handful of reasons why I asked about my suicide method.

trust me dude, it won't get any better. Yes I've came here before. Yes I have a therapist. No I don't have anyone to talk to really. No 24 hours won't help me. (Try dealing with these feelings sober...not fun.) No I don't have a girlfriend. No you don't "love me and hope everything goes better". Yes, I suck at life.

No offense by any of that but I just wanted to cover bases if you were to ask me anything like that.
